description: Kotlin source file defining Data Access Object (DAO) interfaces for database operations related to calendar events, leaves, and astrology data in an Android application.

classes.name: CalendarEventDao
classes.description: DAO interface for accessing calendar event data from the database.

classes.name: LeaveDao
classes.description: DAO interface for accessing leave data from the database.

classes.name: AstrologyDao
classes.description: DAO interface for accessing astrology data from the database.

methods.name: getEventsForDate
methods.description: Fetches calendar events between specified start and end times.

methods.name: getEventsModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events modified after a specific timestamp.

methods.name: insertEvent
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a calendar event in the database.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event by its ID.

methods.name: getLeavesForDate
methods.description: Fetches leave entries between specified start and end times.

methods.name: getLeavesModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves leave entries modified after a certain timestamp.

methods.name: insertLeave
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a leave entry.

methods.name: deleteLeave
methods.description: Deletes a leave entry by its ID.

methods.name: getAstrologyForDate
methods.description: Fetches astrology data for a specific date, limited to one result.

methods.name: getAstrologyModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves astrology entries modified after a specific timestamp.

methods.name: insertAstrology
methods.description: Inserts or replaces an astrology record.
